commit.body:
Add the stdlib-only Python tooling fixture with its CLI, JSON-lines service, interval model, shipped green tests, local ruff policy, and apparatus declaration.

Plant seven independently provable faults across K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, and K8. Declare every practiced span and clean neighbour in FAULTS.json, and provide one isolated probe and context-bearing fix per fault.

Verified with:
